question: Answer his steer: model story beats on the Apocalypse World engine, with ranked outcomes, negative ones included, rolled against a 2d6 table.
note: Third worked example: one story encounter and one faction roll on 2d6 plus a modifier, read as hit (10+), partial (7-9, player picks the cost) or miss (6-, the referee takes the next rung of the faction's ranked consequence list). Battle keeps its percentage odds; option C on the board moves it to 2d6 too. All modifiers, costs and rungs are placeholders; nothing in sprout changes.
